svg.title: Model approval gate
svg.desc: The data scientist registers a model in MLflow and moves the synced Model Package version to staging/pending. IAM denies the data scientist promotion to production and approval. The governance officer promotes the version to production/active and approves it, after which notebooks 04 and 05 deploy it.
svg.text: Two personas, one registry: the approval gate
Applied by the MLflow app service role, so the deny is checked
Evaluated against the calling role, so the data scientist
